scope.description: One exact published 123 Cyber organization refresh for source-verified editorial-profile activation with no autonomous acceptance or publication.

source.title: 123 Cyber | Cybersecurity Risk Management
source.locator: Services, integrated tools and company positioning
source.summary: 123 Cyber describes its Canadian defence-industry GRC services and the 123 AuditPrep, 123 Capture and 123 Enclave product lines.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official products and contact, federal registry and programs, partner delivery evidence, current activity and CPCSC role boundary
followUpQuestions: Which Capture hardware, performance and accreditation boundaries define a deployable configuration?
How are 123 Enclave controls allocated among 123 Cyber, ThinkOn and the customer?
reviewWarnings: Vimy Forge reports 123 Capture use with elements of the Canadian Army and Navy, but public sources do not establish supported hardware, performance benchmarks, accreditation scope or operational-use boundaries.
ThinkOn describes Enclave controls and party roles, but public evidence does not establish 123 Cyber as an accredited CPCSC certification body or allocate every provider-versus-customer control.
Exact-name CanadaBuys, Open Canada contract and federal grant probes found no direct 123 Cyber award, procurement notice or financing record.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed 123 Cyber's current official service catalogue, three named product lines and defence-industry GRC focus.
Confirmed AuditPrep policy, evidence-collection and export functions while retaining the accredited-assessment boundary.
Confirmed active federal corporate identity, corporation number and March 29, 2024 incorporation date.
Confirmed the 123 AuditPrep trademark application and its software-service description without treating IP status as product performance.
Confirmed Black Flight cohort inclusion and the public claim of Capture use with Army and Navy elements; benchmarks remain absent.
Confirmed the ThinkOn and 123 Cyber delivery roles for 123 Enclave while leaving customer control allocation unresolved.
Confirmed federal corroboration of 123 Cyber's Vimy Forge selection and Montreal location without inferring a direct award to the company.
Exact-name CanadaBuys and Open Canada probes found no direct 123 Cyber contract, award or procurement notice suitable for publication.
Exact-name federal grant and contribution probes found no direct 123 Cyber financing record; Vimy Forge funding belongs to the program operator.
Compared official, government, partner and event records; the Arctic Expo listing added no dated field change or material contradiction.

leads.refreshSummary: 123 Cyber is proposed to set editorial profile version to organization_editorial_profile_v1 because its published AuditPrep, Capture, Enclave, Vimy Forge and Calian evidence is already mapped with deployment and accreditation warnings.
intendedChanges: Set editorial_profile_version from null to organization_editorial_profile_v1 after human review; retain all other published fields unchanged.
